description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Lightning 3 with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode], and [Zenith Mode: Prompto] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Prompto
description.text: Increases [Lightning Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Lightning abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Prompto after using two lightning abilities (max 2), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.text: Seven single ranged attacks (0.95/1.00 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Spirit Attack: Prompto

description.name: Attach Lightning 3 with Stacking

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
